fit_reason: This is a polyethylene sea kayak, not a car, truck, motorcycle, boat with gelcoat, PWC or pontoon. It is a human-powered kayak we would not take on as a detailing job.
findings: Yellow plastic hull and deck look clean and evenly colored in all photos
Cockpit interior and seat appear clean with no visible grime or debris
No visible scuffs or fading on the deck around the Vision 150 decal
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Current Designs Vision 150. The deck and cockpit already look clean in your photos, so we don't think a detail would change much here. If you ever sell a car or boat, we'd be glad to send you a quote for a pre-sale detail at your place.
